About Pure Care

Middle East Climate's Trusted Pure Care Experts

Pure Care Auto Accessories TR. L.L.C is a leading car care service provider built for the Middle East climate. We specialize in transforming and protecting vehicles with our comprehensive range of services including car tinting, wrapping, polishing, ceramic coating, PPF, and much more.

Our team of skilled professionals is dedicated to delivering exceptional quality and customer satisfaction. We use only premium products and the latest techniques to ensure your vehicle gets the care it deserves.

What We Offer

Our Services

From exterior and interior detailing to paint protection and finishing treatments, we cover every service your vehicle needs to stay pristine.

Exterior Detailing

Hand wash, clay bar, machine polishing, paint correction, waxing and ceramic protection for a showroom-fresh exterior.

Interior Detailing

Deep vacuum, steam sanitization, seat shampooing, dashboard care and odor removal for a fresh, hygienic cabin.

Paint Protection Film (PPF)

Wrapping, PPF, and related protection solutions — shielding your vehicle against rock chips, scratches, and harsh sun.

Seat Upholstery

Custom seat stitching, ready-made seat covers, floor mats, and more — bespoke craftsmanship and superior comfort.

Additional Detailing Services

Engine bay cleaning, alloy wheel detailing, window polishing and full sanitization to finish every detail.
